original_card.question: Can one exact all-size/compiler, precision, hosting or restoration implication be proved or falsified?
methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.
Find an exact counterexample at the claimed interface boundary.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected review scope and choose one exact all-size or precision implication.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write its quantified inputs and conclusion; find a missing hypothesis or construct a minimal exact adversarial instance.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.
allowed_variations: Choose one tape, precision, hosting or restoration lemma.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.

actual_scope: Audit and resolve PR2471's open question 1 for its exact fixed object: the minimum rank, over an arbitrary field, of a scalar fitting matrix for the strict PR1889 mask on PR1825's 56 matched P112 planes (PR2471 head 5a7c2b681b79d5b5e25fac62aa4bad908525b5ca claims the bracket [48,50]). Independently reconstruct the mask, re-check PR2471's witnesses, decide chi and the port-level 2-fold chromatic number of the plane non-orthogonality graph, and close the bracket if possible.
scope_change_reason: The generic card targets selected-stock all-size/precision/hosting/restoration implications. This session audits one concrete fresh proposed bracket (PR2471, no reviewer yet) with an explicit open question. The narrowing to colourings and minrank was chosen because PR2471's upper witness (2*chi) is not the best disjoint-support bound (that is the 2-fold chromatic number), and an exact decision is cheap and checkable.
bottleneck_link: Side result for the paired-plane scalar-endpoint line (PR1825/PR1889/PR2126/PR2203/PR2471): it fixes the exact scalar channel count of one necessary endpoint obligation. It is not a native copy price and does not change any kappa or the selected result.
stop_rule: Each exact search capped at about 10 CPU-minutes (nice, single process, <1.5 GB); stop at the experiment deadline 2026-10-15T13:01:24Z. All searches finished well inside the cap (default verifier about 2 s; optional two-fold DP about 2 CPU-minutes).
evidence: verify.py (stdlib, exact): omega(G)=24 (194 maximum cliques), chi(G)=25 (exact DP), fractional chi(G)=49/2 (exact fractional-clique (primal) and fractional-colouring (dual) LP certificates), explicit 0/1 rank-49 fit (49 disjoint supports, 11672 mask entries, I_49 on representatives), rank lower bound 49 over every field from a 22-plane clique plus an induced 5-cycle core (proof in README; finite corroboration over GF(2), GF(3)), 8 negative controls rejected, solver controls on C5/C7. Hence the minimum scalar fitting rank is exactly 49 over every field.

open_questions.question: Can a fully charged native implementation realize a 49-channel scalar fit of this mask below the two-unpaid-coordinate budget (PR2471 open question 2)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Only a native cost, not a channel count, can affect a supplier price; rank 49 is now the exact scalar floor for this fixed matching.
open_questions.first_step: Price the explicit 49-support fit here under PR2203's both-payload accounting, including pairing-rank costs and scratch restoration.
open_questions.blocked_by: No accepted native cost model for scalar channels of this endpoint; PR2203/PR2471 remain unreviewed.

open_questions.question: Does a different perfect matching of the 112 P112 ports into nondegenerate planes give a plane graph with a smaller exact fitting rank (for example omega = chi_f, no odd-cycle core)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The 49 floor is specific to PR1825's matching; the C5-core argument shows exactly which plane configurations force the extra channel.
open_questions.first_step: Reuse verify.py's model/LP/DP functions on alternative matchings (Discussion 1587 lists other plane choices) and compare 2*omega, chi_f, chi_2.
open_questions.blocked_by: Enumerating matchings is large; a restricted search class (local rematches as in PR2118) is needed first.
